tasks.label: Docker Compose: Up
tasks.detail: Build (if needed) and start the MergeSE stack in the background on http://localhost:8765.

tasks.label: Docker Compose: Down
tasks.detail: Stop and remove the MergeSE containers (volumes are kept).

tasks.label: Docker Compose: Logs
tasks.detail: Follow logs from the running MergeSE container.

tasks.label: Docker Compose: Restart
tasks.detail: Restart the MergeSE container without rebuilding the image.

tasks.label: MergeSE: Dev server (no Docker)
tasks.detail: Run the Flask dev server directly (requires `pip install .[server]`). Useful when Docker isn't available.
